_doc: ARIA-HIGH-288 — the semantic authority a capability's autonomy evidence is proven under (autonomy_evidence._capability_semantic_authority). A proof carries forward while the authority at its commit equals the authority at the evaluated target, so a change that keeps every version here keeps earned evidence and a change that bumps one resets it. Bump capability_contract_versions[<capability>] when what that capability's proof rows mean changes (its contract, terminal predicate, producer row semantics or count projection); evidence_fold_version when how rows fold into counts and checkpoints changes (EVIDENCE_CHECKPOINT_FOLD_VERSION is this value); upcaster_set_version when a read-time upcaster changes. aria-kernel/tests/invariants/test_capability_semantic_equivalence.py folds a frozen corpus and fails when the output moves without a bump, or when a bump has no pinned output; both this file and those pins are READONLY to ARIA's implementer.
